title: MegaGen presents ten-part Full-Mouth Solution series on Dr. Park’s Implant Surgery Room
html:
MegaGen Implants

Tue. 24. November 2026

share save

SEOUL, South Korea: South Korean implant manufacturer MegaGen is presenting its ten-part Full-Mouth Solution series through the company’s live surgery YouTube channel, Dr. Park’s Implant Surgery Room, hosted by MegaGen CEO Dr Kwang-bum Park. Based on actual clinical cases, the series covers the entire treatment process, from treatment planning to definitive restoration. Through live surgery broadcasts and interactive question-and-answer sessions, the series aims to share clinical experience and practical treatment insights with dental professionals worldwide.

Comprehensive clinical education through full-arch rehabilitation cases

The series presents a variety of full-arch rehabilitation cases, covering each stage of treatment, including patient assessment, treatment planning, implant placement and definitive restoration. Rather than focusing solely on surgical procedures, each episode also examines the treatment approach adopted, the clinical decisions made at different stages of treatment and the final outcome. This format is designed to help clinicians compare treatment strategies and outcomes across cases and gain practical knowledge and clinical insights that can inform their own practice.

Interactive question-and-answer sessions encourage clinical knowledge exchange

Each live surgery is followed by an interactive question-and-answer session in which Dr Park personally answers viewers’ questions. Through discussions centred on the respective clinical case, the sessions provide opportunities to exchange clinical perspectives, address practical treatment challenges and broaden professional knowledge.

The first episode of the series, which aired on 4 November, is titled “All-on-6 implant treatment for a mandibular edentulous case”. The live surgery presented the treatment planning and surgical procedures for a patient with an edentulous mandible. Subsequent episodes will feature a variety of full-arch rehabilitation cases, demonstrating treatment strategies and clinical approaches tailored to individual patients’ clinical needs.

The ten-part video series will be hosted on the Dr. Park’s Implant Surgery Room YouTube channel.

Building on clinical experience and global educational leadership

Dr Park has more than 41 years of clinical experience and has been actively involved in developing implant treatment solutions and advancing clinical education. As part of his commitment to clinical education and professional development, he founded MINEC, MegaGen’s educational and clinical research network for dental professionals worldwide. Drawing on his extensive clinical and educational experience, Dr Park established Dr. Park’s Implant Surgery Room as an educational platform to share practical knowledge and insights through live surgery.

Expanding access to clinical education through international collaboration

MegaGen seeks to facilitate the exchange of clinical experience and treatment approaches in full-mouth implant rehabilitation through international collaboration. Past collaborations have involved prominent clinicians such as Dr Paulo Maló and Prof. João Caramês. Building on these global clinical exchanges, the company has expanded its educational programmes to share a broader range of clinical cases and treatment experiences with dental professionals worldwide. The Full-Mouth Solution series represents a further step towards making practical clinical knowledge more accessible to clinicians.

A MegaGen representative commented, “We hope that sharing the treatment process and clinical decision-making through real cases will help clinicians better understand different treatment approaches and apply these insights to their own clinical practice.”

The ten-part Full-Mouth Solution series runs for approximately ten weeks, and new episodes will be broadcast every Wednesday at 1 p.m. KST. The episodes are available on the Dr. Park’s Implant Surgery Room YouTube channel. Viewers can subscribe to the channel and enable notifications to stay updated on upcoming live sessions.
